quote: Generating pseudo samples for learned tasks involves two steps: (1) PCLL generates a pseudo input utterance x guided by a latent task distribution using the CVAE-based generator. Specifically, for each seen task t′, the model samples a latent variable z t′ from the prior network p ϕ (z t′ |t′) with the constructed prompt prefix g pre t′ as the input. We propose a novel method, PCLL, to enhance generative replay for building lifelong NLU modules of ToD systems.
models: PCLL (Prompt Conditioned VAE for Lifelong Learning)
outputs: Pseudo input utterances (x) and corresponding outputs (y) for intent labels or slot-value pairs.

Pseudo samples for intent detection and slot filling tasks are generated using a CVAE-based generator conditioned on prompts, e.g., 'For an utterance from the BANKING task, "I already have one of your cards, how do I link them?" has the following intent', followed by the generated intent.
